issues.current_text: Trump ameaçou destruir 'todas as usinas e pontes' até terça
issues.previous_text: Trump deu ao Irã 48 horas para reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz ou enfrentar ataques a usinas e pontes
issues.suggestion: This is the same ultimatum restated. The Apr 5 edition already reported the 48h deadline. Cut or reduce to a passing reference ('com o prazo de terça se aproximando') and focus only on what's NEW since the threat was made (ceasefire proposal, South Pars strike, etc.).

issues.current_text: Drones iranianos atingiram usinas e dessalinização no Kuwait e instalações no Bahrein e Abu Dhabi
issues.previous_text: Drones iranianos atingiram um tanque de petróleo no Bahrein e a petroquímica Borouge em Abu Dhabi, onde os Emirados interceptaram 23 mísseis balísticos e 56 drones
issues.suggestion: The Bahrain and Abu Dhabi attacks were already covered on Apr 5 (and Kuwait attacks on Apr 4). The Apr 6 sources (Al Jazeera 04/05, Fortune 04/05) are the same reporting window as Apr 5's edition. If these are genuinely new strikes, specify dates and new targets. If they're the same events, cut entirely — readers already know.

issues.current_text: A Artemis II faz hoje o sobrevoo lunar mais próximo desde o Apollo: a Orion passará a 4.070 milhas da superfície e às 13h56 EDT quebrará o recorde do Apollo 13
issues.previous_text: A Artemis II entrou na esfera de influência gravitacional da Lua, com passagem lunar agendada para amanhã. Koch e Hansen pilotaram manualmente a cápsula Orion por 41 minutos
issues.suggestion: Third consecutive edition covering Artemis II (Apr 4: midpoint, Apr 5: gravitational sphere + manual piloting, Apr 6: flyby + record). The Apollo 13 record is a genuinely new milestone, but readers may feel fatigue. Consider a shorter mention focused solely on the record ('A Orion quebrou o recorde do Apollo 13...') without re-explaining the mission context.

issues.current_text: Goldman Sachs projeta 49% de crescimento em semicondutores até o fim do ano, com hardware de IA tocando $700bi no Q4
issues.previous_text: Vendas globais de semicondutores atingiram US$88,8bi em fevereiro — alta de 61,8% em relação ao mesmo mês do ano passado — e o setor caminha para US$1 trilhão em 2026
issues.suggestion: Same 'chips are booming' angle two days apart. The Goldman forecast adds little beyond the SIA's $1T projection from Apr 4. Cut the Goldman line or fold it into the Samsung EUV order as context ('a encomenda chega num mercado que o Goldman projeta crescer 49%...') rather than presenting it as standalone news.

issues.current_text: Gary Marcus demoliu a narrativa: a FDA enviou carta de advertência por misbranding...
issues.previous_text: Gary Marcus, neurocientista da NYU e crítico vocal de IA: 'Imaginem se calculadoras precisassem desse aviso'
issues.suggestion: Gary Marcus appears as the designated skeptic/debunker in two consecutive editions (Apr 5: Copilot disclaimer, Apr 6: Medvi fraud). His Medvi takedown is substantive, but attribute it differently — cite the specific findings without leading with his name, or use 'investigações subsequentes revelaram' to avoid the pattern of 'Gary Marcus desmonta X' becoming a recurring segment.

issues.current_text: a empresa não está pronta para IPO em 2026 — Altman quer ir a público no Q4 mesmo projetando $121bi em computação e $85bi em perdas em 2028
issues.previous_text: o COO Brad Lightcap migrou para 'projetos especiais'... tudo em meio aos preparativos para o IPO
issues.suggestion: OpenAI-in-chaos-before-IPO has been the frame for three editions (Apr 4: exec departures, Apr 5: shareholder table leak, Apr 6: CFO excluded + IPO disagreement). The CFO story is genuinely new, but explicitly acknowledge the pattern rather than presenting each as isolated drama — e.g., 'A turbulência pré-IPO da OpenAI continua:' instead of framing it as fresh chaos.

issues.current_text: Separadamente, o Drift Protocol revelou que seu exploit de $270M...
issues.previous_text: Separadamente, a Microsoft lançou três modelos próprios...
issues.suggestion: Minor but noticeable: 'Separadamente' is used as a transition to pivot between unrelated stories in both editions. Use 'Em outro front,' 'Fora da IA,' 'No mundo crypto,' or just start the sentence directly.

issues.current_text: Uma proposta de cessar-fogo de 45 dias mediada por Egito, Paquistão e Turquia foi rejeitada por Teerã
issues.previous_text: Quarenta nações pediram a reabertura do Estreito de Ormuz sem chegar a acordo, e Rússia, China e França vetaram resolução da ONU
issues.suggestion: Diplomacy-fails-again is a recurring beat in the Iran coverage (Apr 4: 40 nations fail + UN veto, Apr 6: ceasefire proposal rejected). The new proposal IS news, but frame it against the pattern of failed attempts rather than presenting it standalone — readers already expect diplomatic failure.

summary: Moderate repetition. Iran coverage has the most overlap — Trump's ultimatum is restated, Gulf drone attacks may duplicate Apr 5, and the diplomacy-fails frame recurs. Artemis II runs for a 3rd day. Gary Marcus appears as critic in back-to-back editions. Semiconductor boom is the same angle as Apr 4.
